input.summary:
P3 parlour furnished in parts/room-19.mjs: a spruce-stair chair facing the table at each end of the west column (x40, z10 and z12), a spruce fence and top-slab table at z11 with a flower pot, and a hanging lantern on an iron chain over the clear east lane (x41).
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with 7 blocks placed for this part, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines. Light is 12 min on all 5 floor cells, 0 dark; nothing floats on my cells and the entrance cell (41,3,10) and the lane stay clear.
Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE for every room, not just this one: the front steps, porch and stair hall that lead in are not built in this copy yet, so the check can't confirm the lane is walkable.
left: Walkability not verified: `mcd room` and `mcd walk` report 'no way in' for all rooms because the entrance path (front steps, wraparound porch, hall opening x42 z10) is not built in this copy yet. Re-run `$MCD room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "P3 parlour"` after the porch and stair hall parts land.

The plan's bay window (x39..40 z9, y4..5) is not in the shell grid as a glass opening yet (the grid shows wall at x40 z9); the fittings part owns it. The chair at (40,3,10) sits under it with its back on the bay wall, so the window must stay at y4..5 with nothing built above the chair's back.
plan.md and elements.md have no checklist item specific to this room, so nothing was ticked. The site-wide 'every room lit' item is satisfied for this room (min light 12) but it is not mine to tick.

waste.what: Worked out the 2x3 floor layout, each stair's facing (sitter's side vs back to the wall) and the lane cells by hand from the plan grid.
waste.cost: About 6 coordinate checks and 2 facing corrections in my head, no retries on the file.
waste.tool: A `mcd plan` option that prints the room's floor with each wall's facing and each cell's access direction (which way a sitter faces a seat), so a chair's facing comes out of the tool.
